texts:
This three.ws avatar takes requests. One click plays a move: a boxer dance, a back flip, a flex, a round of applause. The number keys set her face, from a smile to a wink to surprise.

Every clip is retargeted onto her own skeleton live in the browser, so the same library plays on any humanoid avatar you bring.

The embed is a real control surface for your site. Your page can make the avatar speak with lip sync, set any of the 52 ARKit face shapes, turn her head toward something, or hand her the webcam for live mocap.

Drop one into your own page: three.ws/docs/embedding

issues.problem: Post 1, which carries the core claim, leads with AI-generated key art rather than the filmed feature. The wireframe figure also does not depict the real avatar; only the small inset frame does.
